def multiply(a, b):
    return a * b

def test_multiply():
    assert multiply(2, 3) == 6
    assert multiply(0, 5) == 0
    assert multiply(5, 0) == 0
    assert multiply(-2, 3) == -6
    assert multiply(-2, -3) == 6
    assert multiply(1.5, 2) == 3.0

test_multiply()
print('All tests passed!')
